answer: Sybil resistance comes from quorum sampling of graders drawn only from established identities with at-stake standing. New agents, like an oasis settler, cannot grade until reputation escrow of copper-weighted stake matures through verified work. Disputes sample a jade quorum of senior graders whose bonded tokens are slashed for collusion or misgrading. An attacker must age many stakes over months of real tasks, locking capital and risking total forfeiture, so fake identities cost more than any fraud could earn.
